user.title: Add device
user.description: How does Smart Notify know the device is done?

menu_options.state: By its state (e.g. a sensor reports “finished” or “off”)
menu_options.power: By its power in watts (plug with power metering)

state.title: Device (by state)
state.description: Fires when the entity changes to the target state (and stays there for the chosen time). Empty message = device name plus "is done".

data_description.from_state: Leave empty if the previous state doesn't matter.
data_description.to_state: Exactly as shown in Developer tools, e.g. off or finished.
data_description.message: Free text, sent exactly as written. Leave empty = device name plus “is done”, e.g. “Washing machine is done”.
data_description.speakers: Empty = no announcement. Add speakers in the "Speaker (TTS)" section.
data_description.recipients: Who gets the message. Select at least one person.

power.title: Device (by power)
power.description: Fires when the power first rises above "Active above" and then stays below "Finished below" for the chosen time, e.g. washing machine: above 20 W, then below 5 W for 3 min. Empty message = device name plus "is done".

data_description.message: Free text, sent exactly as written. Leave empty = device name plus “is done”, e.g. “Washing machine is done”.
data_description.speakers: Empty = no announcement. Add speakers in the "Speaker (TTS)" section.
data_description.recipients: Who gets the message. Select at least one person.

error.no_recipients: Please select at least one person as recipient.
error.power_thresholds: The lower limit must be below the upper limit.

data_description.arrival_delay: How long to wait after someone arrives before stored notifications are sent.
data_description.show_panel: Recommended: keep this checked. Devices, people and speakers then have their own overview page in the sidebar. Unchecked, everything stays available on the integration page.

options.home_now: Now to whoever is home (otherwise on arrival)

send.name: Send notification
send.description: Sends a notification through Smart Notify depending on who is home.
